steps.content: Crunch, crunch, crunch.
Creepy chewing sounds can be heard from every corner of the room.
Everyone looks at the scene in front of them, the blood draining from their faces.
To complete McGrath's game, the three of you have joined the crowd looking for clues and "game rules." Yet no one expected to see something like this a mere half hour later.

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: "The poor kitten is about to be eaten by a monster. You must pick something valuable to swap it out."

steps.speaker: Strange Voice
steps.content: "Please circle your chosen items in the picture below. Note that once selected, you will lose these items."
It's the voice you heard in the pool! Though you heard it just faintly, you can still remember! You stare at the door in shock, trying to figure out what's going on.
After a while, the door swings open. You see the twisted face of a guest who gets sucked into the weird contraption before getting the chance to scream.
On a picture next to the contraption, you see dried roses and paper on a table circled in red.
Finally, the chewing stops. The big mouth in the room opens with a snap.
Everyone can see that in the center of the mouth, there is a plate of fresh oranges—the same color as that man's hair.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: D-d-d-did he really get eaten...?

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content: Aaahhh...!!!!
The guests scream in terror, as if they were going to be devoured by the big mouth next.
Yet aside from the oranges, you also feel Mania emanating from the big mouth!
It's an unfamiliar type of Mania. You don't know if it's from the Ogygia Villa, which belongs to the Thaumas Society in the first place, or some mutation with that Chef McGrath.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: S-so this is the head chef's game? Whoever loses gets turned into... food?!
Kelvin cowers, grabbing onto your sleeve instinctively.
The guests' faces contort hideously. Remembering what they had just eaten, they're overcome by disgust and nausea. Most can't help but vomit.
You pat Kelvin's hand. You ponder her words as you comfort her: Lose... Disappear... Turn into food?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps... the game already started before she announced the rules?
You remember the melted ice cream by the elevator and suddenly realize something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've heard that voice before. It was when I got pushed into the pool. At that time, something was dragging me down, and that voice asked me if I wanted to leave everything behind to have fun...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That question was part of the game—the selection of the worthy had already started at the pool party!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Hahahaha... My dear guests, so you finally realized it!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: That's right! The game started a long time ago!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Those on the top floor disappeared because they gave in to their hedonism!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: And then we have those vain social climbers who brawled to get the first spot in the elevator. As for this gentleman... he wouldn't even care to save a little critter!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Tell me, what honor do these people have?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: This is only what they deserve! Hahahaha...
McGrath's words are clear: these challenges are her way of selecting the worthy.
The top floor was a test of "temptation," while the second floor was a test of compassion.
McGrath's sharp laughs echo in the air, plunging everyone in rage and despair.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: You didn't tell us anything about that! How despicable!

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: What's so dishonorable about eating an extra bit of food?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: It's quite dishonorable indeed. You don't even have this bit of self-control?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Think about Miss Cabernet! She would never eat anything short of perfect!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: One must be like her to make it to the end. Got it?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: After all, how can I allow anyone tainted to dine with Miss Cabernet?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: This is my surprise gift for you, Miss Cabernet! To give you the best dining experience, I will ensure that you're neither lonely nor pestered!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: You will approve of me, right?!
After saying this, McGrath falls silent.
Yet because of this last sentence, all eyes focus on Cabernet.
All the previous fawning, idolization and flattery have vanished, replaced by fear and disgust.

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content: What... this is all for Miss Cabernet?!
The crowd erupts in discussion, echoing like frogs croaking in unison.
They can't touch the dreaded gamemaster, but they can touch Cabernet. Gripped by fear and anger, they all turn against her.

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content: Is Cabernet behind all this?

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content: Then she's a wicked accomplice of that crazy chef! She's simply picking the ingredients she likes!

steps.speaker: Panicked Guest
steps.content: Wait a minute... wait a minute... I remember it now!

steps.speaker: Panicked Guest
steps.content: I've read a story about Cabernet on a blog!
A guest in green suddenly remembers something and grabs her friend anxiously.
You recognize her as the blogger girl who you bumped into before.

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: Cabernet was born into a prominent Eastside family... Day in day out, she ate the most magnificent delicacies...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: Thus... This made Cabernet an extremely picky epicure. She never ate anything she considered short of perfect...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: To satisfy their daughter's exquisite palate, her parents searched high and low for the rarest delicacies for Cabernet... But for a long time, they couldn't find anything to her standards...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: Then... one day... a chef bravely volunteered to serve Cabernet a dish...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: The chef lifted up the cloche, revealing a string of fragrant grapes on the plate...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: The delectable grapes caught Cabernet's attention. She couldn't help but pop one into her mouth...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: She suddenly realized that grape was the most delicious thing she had ever tasted... So she gobbled up the rest one by one!
The lady in green flails her hands dramatically, using wild gestures to tell the story about Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: But Cabernet was not gratified. So she asked the chef, "Are there any more of these delicious grapes?"

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: And do you know what the chef said?
The girl in green asks the crowd suspensefully, fully aware that all eyes are on her.

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: Let me tell you... that chef said...

steps.speaker: Blogger Girl
steps.content: "I only have this one child!"

steps.speaker: Guests
steps.content: Aaahhh...!!
The guest's low, grim words frighten the others. They huddle closer together, isolating the three of you, and point any sharp objects they can find at you.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Is this part of the surprise? Haha... You have the right to believe that story or not.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I know you won't believe anything I say at this point, and I am not in the mood for lecturing anyone...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: People shouldn't be taking cues from misinformation... but to me, it doesn't matter.
Of course, no one is willing to believe her. They rush about looking for things that can be used as weapons, preparing to attack.
These developments shock you. It had been a simple case involving some weird games, yet now, people are under the threat of being literally turned into food if they lost.
The person who dragged you into the mire is standing next to you, but she is also trapped, facing the angry guests.
Such strong emotions are really an incubator for Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's the point of doing this now?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like that woman said, if you can't "prove your honor," you'll become food!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you want to turn into food and get eaten?
Upon hearing your shouts, the crowd pauses to look at each other. Those at the very front hesitate a while, then scowl and put away their weapons.
You know it's not because their view of Cabernet has changed, but because they're afraid of getting eaten.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Finally... They finally stopped...
Seeing the crowd scatter... Kelvin lets out a trembling sigh.
She looks worriedly at Cabernet but doesn't dare go up to her, instead choosing to stay by your side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Cabernet...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What, you believe that story, too?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, I don't really believe ridiculous stories from some blog.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But... I do want to know about your lost treasures, and the truth about your ingredients.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are McGrath's obsession. All her actions stem from you... So, something like turning people into ingredients...
Cabernet stands loftily a few steps from you. She doesn't look like a participant in this game, or even this party.
She looks as if she only belongs in the head chair of a magnificent banquet table.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: First of all, I want to thank you for saving me just now... Though we're besieged on all sides right now, this makes me feel that at least I can trust you.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: It's quite funny, actually. I don't have many people around me who I can trust.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: So...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: You're right. My treasures, my precious ingredients... are two people.
Though you had your suspicions before, you're still caught off guard, and have trouble linking the two words together.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I cherish them very much... They showed me what a truly honorable soul is like, transcending any social status or identities.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: <size=30>I did become a picky epicure after I met them, but it's because they showed me what "a truly satisfying taste" is like... Later, however, many began regarding me as some sort of guide. There were even rumors that only chefs whose dishes I approved of are good. But I don't want my words to become the judging standards for a dish or even a person.</size>

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Just like how I don't want McGrath to judge my treasures or preferences by her standards. Plus... she stole my treasures, which is unforgivable in the first place.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: What I want right now is not some surprise or dinner. I only wish I could take back from her, the treasures that belong to me.
You and Kelvin fall silent. This game is so stupid, and Cabernet's words are so absurd, but you've already gotten this far.
Macchiato is waiting for you, and Kelvin is still by your side. You must retrieve and protect them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We will certainly fulfill our promise, but I also hope that you can be honest with us. You are McGrath's heart's desire, so I think the breakthrough will be with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I still need to verify your story, but... it will have to wait after some more pressing matters.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Don't worry, I also promised you... that I will help and protect you.
